templates.name: Clean clinic starter
templates.description: Earlier clinic starter. New dental, physiotherapy, chiropractic and veterinary jobs use care-modern unless this preview already names clinic-clean. Appearance is unfinished.
templates.adaptation: Customise branding and sourced business content. Keep the layout and spacing. Create a new version for design changes.

templates.name: Modern care
templates.description: Accepted layout for a new dental, physiotherapy, chiropractic or veterinary clinic. Home, services, team, reviews and contact use that clinic’s published facts. A prices page appears for a labelled demo, or when the clinic’s own fees are recorded. The brand accent colours the page, including its pale tint. There is no shop or cart.
templates.adaptation: Keep this layout. Fill name, logo colour, services, practitioners, hours and reviews from the official site. Sample people and sample fees stay on labelled demos. Record published fees only when the clinic lists them.
